title: Loop the Loopies!
abstract: arXiv:2607.16051v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present Loopie, the most powerful open-source looped Transformer to date. The Loopie series consists of two Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models: a 20B-parameter model with 2B active parameters and a 6B parameter model with 0.6B active parameters. Looped Transformers have long faced a challenge: given an N-fold pre-training compute, increasing the parameter count by a factor of N usually outperforms looping N times. Loopie addresses this challenge. Extensive ablation studies, including comparisons with a vanilla 30B-A3B model, show that Loopie substantially outperforms vanilla Transformer baselines trained with the same compute budget. With a novel post-training method, Loopie develops strong reasoning abilities and achieves frontier-level reasoning performance.

translated_abstract: 我们推出了 Loopie，这是迄今最强大的开源循环 Transformer。Loopie 系列包含两个混合专家模型：一个总参数量为 20B、激活参数为 2B 的模型，以及一个总参数量为 6B、激活参数为 0.6B 的模型。循环 Transformer 长期以来一直面临一个挑战：在给定 N 倍预训练计算量的情况下，将参数量扩大 N 倍通常优于将模型循环 N 次。Loopie 解决了这一挑战。大量消融实验（包括与标准 30B-A3B 模型的对比）表明，Loopie 在相同计算预算下显著优于标准 Transformer 基线。借助一种新颖的后训练方法，Loopie 培养出强大的推理能力，达到了前沿水平的推理性能。
tldr: Loopie 是迄今最强大的开源循环 Transformer，它解决了循环次数不如扩大参数量的长期难题，在相同计算预算下显著超越标准 Transformer，并通过新颖的后训练方法实现了前沿水平的推理能力。
en_tdlr: Loopie is the most powerful open-source looped Transformer to date, which overcomes the long-standing challenge that looping underperforms scaling parameters, substantially outperforms vanilla Transformer baselines under the same compute budget, and achieves frontier-level reasoning performance with a novel post-training method.
